tools.name: raklet_get_account
tools.description: Return the organisation the API token belongs to. Use it first to confirm the connection. Raklet API: GET /public/account/me.

tools.name: raklet_list_languages
tools.description: List the language codes Raklet accepts for contacts, for example when creating one. Raklet API: GET /common/languages.

tools.name: raklet_list_contacts
tools.description: List the organisation's contacts (members), one page at a time. The optional q is a base64-encoded JSON filter in the form Raklet expects. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts.

tools.name: raklet_get_contact
tools.description: Return one contact's full details: addresses, emails, phones, education and work history. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts/{organisationMembershipId}/details.

tools.name: raklet_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the organisation. Writes a member record. Raklet may send the contact an e-mail depending on the organisation's settings. Raklet API: POST /organisations/{organisationId}/contacts.

tools.name: raklet_list_corporate_members
tools.description: List the organisation's corporate members (companies), one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/corporateMembers.

tools.name: raklet_list_tags
tools.description: List the organisation's contact tags (for example committees or volunteer groups). Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/tags.

tools.name: raklet_get_tag
tools.description: Return one tag with its details. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/tags/{id}.

tools.name: raklet_list_events
tools.description: List the organisation's events in a date range. Both dates are required. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events.

tools.name: raklet_get_event
tools.description: Return one event's details. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events/{id}.

tools.name: raklet_list_event_ticket_options
tools.description: List the ticket options (prices and types) of one event. Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/events/{id}/ticketoptions.

tools.name: raklet_list_posts
tools.description: List news posts of the organisation's community feed, one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/posts.

tools.name: raklet_get_post
tools.description: Return one news post with its body and status. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/posts/{postId}.

tools.name: raklet_create_post
tools.description: Create a news post in the organisation's community feed. Members can read it once it is published. Read the status field of the reply to see whether it is a draft or published. Raklet API: POST /organisations/{organisationId}/posts.

tools.name: raklet_list_membership_plans
tools.description: List the organisation's membership plans and their prices. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/plans.

tools.name: raklet_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List the organisation's membership subscriptions (which contact holds which plan). Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/subscriptions.

tools.name: raklet_list_payments
tools.description: List the membership payments recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/payments.

tools.name: raklet_list_debts
tools.description: List the outstanding debts (amounts a contact still owes) recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/debts.

tools.name: raklet_list_donations
tools.description: List the donations recorded for the organisation. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/donations.

tools.name: raklet_list_applications
tools.description: List the membership application form submissions, one page at a time. Raklet API: GET /organisations/{organisationId}/applications.

tools.name: raklet_get_organisation_settings
tools.description: Return the organisation's settings (name, portal and membership options). Raklet API: GET /app/organisations/{organisationId}/settings.

tools.name: raklet_list_action_logs
tools.description: List the organisation's action log: who changed what and when. Filter by date range, action or contact. Raklet API: GET /app/actionlogs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: raklet_get_contact, raklet_list_event_ticket_options, raklet_list_posts, raklet_get_post, raklet_create_post · Private data: raklet_get_account, raklet_list_languages, raklet_list_contacts, raklet_get_contact, raklet_create_contact, raklet_list_tags, raklet_list_subscriptions, raklet_list_debts, raklet_list_action_logs · Public sink: raklet_create_contact, raklet_get_post, raklet_create_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: raklet_get_contact, raklet_list_event_ticket_options, raklet_list_posts, raklet_get_post, raklet_create_post · Private data: raklet_get_account, raklet_list_languages, raklet_list_contacts, raklet_get_contact, raklet_create_contact, raklet_list_tags, raklet_list_subscriptions, raklet_list_debts, raklet_list_action_logs · Public sink: raklet_create_contact, raklet_get_post, raklet_create_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
